title: Configurational Taxonomy of Planetary Bodies: A Fuzzy-Set QCA of Orbital Hierarchy, Dynamical Dominance, Composition, and Evolution
domain: planetary science / comparative methods / set-theoretic analysis / taxonomy
summary: A falsification-first configurational taxonomy of Solar System bodies. The frozen 50-body frame now has a raw physical layer, a separate orbital-geometry layer, and a reproducible derived-physics layer. JPL physical/orbital information covers 34 cases; the remaining 16 small bodies remain explicitly un-ingested behind a frozen SBDB snapshot route. Calibration and QCA solutions remain unopened.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C user-requested project registered 2026-09-24. Pilot-0 froze the 50-body frame and anti-circularity model ladder. Physical-core v0.1 ingested JPL values for 34 cases and source-faithful Margot/Soter code. Pilot-1 then added JPL satellite mean elements for 21 satellites, explicitly derived temporary heliocentric semimajor axes for the 13 direct-Sun planet/dwarf rows from JPL periods, generated derived physics for all 34 currently complete cases, and froze a missingness/provenance audit without inspecting QCA solutions.

tables.status: case frame + physical core + orbit geometry + derived physics
